consumer: src/pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup, which presents a Wear/Wield/Empty/Skip uilist and reads the player's selection via amenu.query() to perform the chosen disposition of the too-heavy item
scope: only the single problematic picked-up item, dispositioned for the player's own character via the active input loop
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup — builds a uilist (Wear if armor, Wield, Empty if has children) and calls amenu.query(), returning the player's chosen pickup_answer that the engine then acts on
divergence: A too-heavy item is armor; a silent default selects WIELD (disposing the currently wielded weapon) while the player would have chosen WEAR or to skip — the menu answer diverges from any default/no-op, breaking gameplay
